+type consistentHashIR struct {
+	disable         bool
+	headers         []*envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy
+	cookies         []*envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy
+	queryParameters []*envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy
+	filterState     []*envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy
+	sourceIp        *envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy
+	policies        []*envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy
+}
+
+var _ PolicySubIR = &consistentHashIR{}
+
+func (c *consistentHashIR) Equals(other PolicySubIR) bool {
+	otherCH, ok := other.(*consistentHashIR)
+	if !ok {
+		return false
+	}
+	if c == nil && otherCH == nil {
+		return true
+	}
+	if c == nil || otherCH == nil {
+		return false
+	}
+	if c.disable != otherCH.disable {
+		return false
+	}
+	if !slices.EqualFunc(c.headers, otherCH.headers, func(a, b *envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy) bool {
+		return proto.Equal(a, b)
+	}) {
+		return false
+	}
+	if !slices.EqualFunc(c.cookies, otherCH.cookies, func(a, b *envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy) bool {

+	}) {

+	if !slices.EqualFunc(c.queryParameters, otherCH.queryParameters, func(a, b *envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy) bool {
+		return proto.Equal(a, b)
+	}) {
+		return false
+	}
+	if !slices.EqualFunc(c.filterState, otherCH.filterState, func(a, b *envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy) bool {
+		return proto.Equal(a, b)

+	})

+func (c *consistentHashIR) Validate() error {
+	if c == nil || c.disable {
+		return nil
+	}
+	for _, hp := range c.policies {
+		if hdr := hp.GetHeader(); hdr != nil && hdr.GetRegexRewrite() != nil && hdr.GetRegexRewrite().GetPattern() != nil {
+			if err := regexutils.CheckRegexString(hdr.GetRegexRewrite().GetPattern().GetRegex()); err != nil {
+				return fmt.Errorf("invalid regex pattern in consistentHash header: %w", err)
+			}
+		}
+		if err := hp.Validate(); err != nil {
+			return err
+		}
+	}
+	return nil
+}

+func (c *consistentHashIR) buildPolicies() {
+	if c.disable {
+		c.policies = nil
+		return
+	}
+	var policies []*envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy
+	policies = append(policies, c.headers...)
+	policies = append(policies, c.cookies...)
+	policies = append(policies, c.queryParameters...)
+	policies = append(policies, c.filterState...)
+	if c.sourceIp != nil {
+		policies = append(policies, c.sourceIp)
+	}

+		policies = []*envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy{

+					},
+				},
+				Terminal: false,
+			},
+		}
+	}
+	c.policies = policies

+func (c *consistentHashIR) clone() *consistentHashIR {
+	if c == nil {
+		return nil
+	}

+		headers:         slices.Clone(c.headers),
+		cookies:         slices.Clone(c.cookies),
+		queryParameters: slices.Clone(c.queryParameters),
+		filterState:     slices.Clone(c.filterState),
+		sourceIp:        c.sourceIp,
+		policies:        slices.Clone(c.policies),
+	}
+	return out
+}

+func parseCookieTTL(s string) (time.Duration, error) {
+	if secs, err := strconv.ParseInt(s, 10, 64); err == nil {
+		if secs < 0 {
+			return 0, fmt.Errorf("cookie ttl cannot be negative: %q", s)
+		}
+		return time.Duration(secs) * time.Second, nil
+	}
+	d, err := time.ParseDuration(s)
+	if err != nil {
+		return 0, fmt.Errorf("invalid cookie ttl %q: %w", s, err)
+	}
+	if d < 0 {
+		return 0, fmt.Errorf("cookie ttl cannot be negative: %q", s)
+	}
+	return d, nil
+}

+func constructConsistentHash(spec kgateway.TrafficPolicySpec, out *trafficPolicySpecIr) error {
+	if spec.ConsistentHash == nil {
+		return nil
+	}
+
+	ch := spec.ConsistentHash
+	if ptr.Deref(ch.Disable, false) {
+		if len(ch.Headers) > 0 || len(ch.Cookies) > 0 || len(ch.QueryParameters) > 0 || len(ch.FilterState) > 0 || ch.SourceIP != nil {
+			return fmt.Errorf("when consistentHash.disable is true, no other consistentHash fields may be set")
+		}
+		out.consistentHash = &consistentHashIR{
+			disable: true,
+		}
+		return nil
+	}
+
+	ir := &consistentHashIR{}
+
+	// 1. Headers (case-insensitive deduplication preserving first occurrence's casing)
+	seenHeaders := make(map[string]struct{}, len(ch.Headers))
+	for _, h := range ch.Headers {
+		key := strings.ToLower(h.HeaderName)
+		if _, exists := seenHeaders[key]; exists {
+			continue
+		}
+		seenHeaders[key] = struct{}{}
+
+		headerPolicy := &envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy_Header{
+			HeaderName: h.HeaderName,
+		}
+		if h.RegexRewrite != nil {
+			headerPolicy.RegexRewrite = &envoy_type_matcher_v3.RegexMatchAndSubstitute{
+				Pattern: &envoy_type_matcher_v3.RegexMatcher{
+					Regex: h.RegexRewrite.Pattern,
+				},
+				Substitution: h.RegexRewrite.Substitution,
+			}
+		}
+		ir.headers = append(ir.headers, &envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy{
+			PolicySpecifier: &envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy_Header_{
+				Header: headerPolicy,
+			},
+			Terminal: ptr.Deref(h.Terminal, false),
+		})
+	}
+
+	// 2. Cookies (deduplicated by name)
+	seenCookies := make(map[string]struct{}, len(ch.Cookies))
+	for _, c := range ch.Cookies {
+		if _, exists := seenCookies[c.Name]; exists {
+			continue
+		}
+		seenCookies[c.Name] = struct{}{}
+
+		cookiePolicy := &envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy_Cookie{
+			Name: c.Name,
+			Path: ptr.Deref(c.Path, ""),
+		}
+		if c.TTL != nil && *c.TTL != "" {
+			d, err := parseCookieTTL(*c.TTL)
+			if err != nil {
+				return err
+			}
+			cookiePolicy.Ttl = durationpb.New(d)
+		}
+		if len(c.Attributes) > 0 {
+			attrs := make([]*envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy_CookieAttribute, 0, len(c.Attributes))
+			for _, attr := range c.Attributes {
+				attrs = append(attrs, &envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy_CookieAttribute{
+					Name:  attr.Name,
+					Value: attr.Value,
+				})
+			}
+			cookiePolicy.Attributes = attrs
+		}
+		ir.cookies = append(ir.cookies, &envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy{
+			PolicySpecifier: &envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy_Cookie_{
+				Cookie: cookiePolicy,
+			},
+			Terminal: ptr.Deref(c.Terminal, false),
+		})
+	}
+
+	// 3. QueryParameters (deduplicated by name)
+	seenQueryParams := make(map[string]struct{}, len(ch.QueryParameters))
+	for _, q := range ch.QueryParameters {
+		if _, exists := seenQueryParams[q.Name]; exists {
+			continue
+		}
+		seenQueryParams[q.Name] = struct{}{}
+
+		ir.queryParameters = append(ir.queryParameters, &envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy{
+			PolicySpecifier: &envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy_QueryParameter_{
+				QueryParameter: &envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy_QueryParameter{
+					Name: q.Name,
+				},
+			},
+			Terminal: ptr.Deref(q.Terminal, false),
+		})
+	}
+
+	// 4. FilterState (deduplicated by key)
+	seenFilterState := make(map[string]struct{}, len(ch.FilterState))
+	for _, f := range ch.FilterState {
+		if _, exists := seenFilterState[f.Key]; exists {
+			continue
+		}
+		seenFilterState[f.Key] = struct{}{}
+
+		ir.filterState = append(ir.filterState, &envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy{
+			PolicySpecifier: &envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy_FilterState_{
+				FilterState: &envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy_FilterState{
+					Key: f.Key,
+				},
+			},
+			Terminal: ptr.Deref(f.Terminal, false),
+		})
+	}
+
+	// 5. SourceIP
+	if ch.SourceIP != nil {
+		ir.sourceIp = &envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy{
+			PolicySpecifier: &envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy_ConnectionProperties_{
+				ConnectionProperties: &envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy_ConnectionProperties{
+					SourceIp: true,
+				},
+			},
+			Terminal: ptr.Deref(ch.SourceIP.Terminal, false),
+		}
+	}
+
+	ir.buildPolicies()
+	out.consistentHash = ir
+	return nil
+}
+
+func applyConsistentHash(consistentHash *consistentHashIR, out *envoyroutev3.Route) {
+	if consistentHash == nil || out == nil {
+		return
+	}
+	action := out.GetRoute()
+	if action == nil {
+		return
+	}
+	if consistentHash.disable {
+		action.HashPolicy = nil
+		return
+	}
+	action.HashPolicy = consistentHash.policies
+}
+
+func mergeConsistentHash(
+	p1, p2 *TrafficPolicy,
+	p2Ref *ir.AttachedPolicyRef,
+	p2MergeOrigins ir.MergeOrigins,
+	opts policy.MergeOptions,
+	mergeOrigins ir.MergeOrigins,
+	tpOpts TrafficPolicyMergeOpts,
+) {
+	if tpOpts.ConsistentHash != "" {
+		opts.Strategy = policy.ToInternalMergeStrategy(tpOpts.ConsistentHash)
+	}
+
+	if p2.spec.consistentHash == nil {
+		return
+	}
+
+	if p1.spec.consistentHash == nil {
+		p1.spec.consistentHash = p2.spec.consistentHash.clone()
+		mergeOrigins.SetOne("consistentHash", p2Ref, p2MergeOrigins)
+		return
+	}
+
+	var high, low *consistentHashIR
+	p1IsHigh := true
+	switch opts.Strategy {
+	case policy.OverridableShallowMerge, policy.OverridableDeepMerge:
+		high = p2.spec.consistentHash
+		low = p1.spec.consistentHash
+		p1IsHigh = false
+	default:
+		// AugmentedShallowMerge, AugmentedDeepMerge
+		high = p1.spec.consistentHash
+		low = p2.spec.consistentHash
+		p1IsHigh = true
+	}
+
+	if high.disable {
+		if !p1IsHigh {
+			p1.spec.consistentHash = high.clone()
+			mergeOrigins.SetOne("consistentHash", p2Ref, p2MergeOrigins)
+		}
+		return
+	}
+
+	if low.disable {
+		if !p1IsHigh {
+			p1.spec.consistentHash = high.clone()
+			mergeOrigins.SetOne("consistentHash", p2Ref, p2MergeOrigins)
+		}
+		return
+	}
+
+	merged := &consistentHashIR{
+		headers: unionHashPolicies(high.headers, low.headers, func(hp *envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy) string {
+			return strings.ToLower(hp.GetHeader().GetHeaderName())
+		}),
+		cookies: unionHashPolicies(high.cookies, low.cookies, func(hp *envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy) string {
+			return hp.GetCookie().GetName()
+		}),
+		queryParameters: unionHashPolicies(high.queryParameters, low.queryParameters, func(hp *envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy) string {
+			return hp.GetQueryParameter().GetName()
+		}),
+		filterState: unionHashPolicies(high.filterState, low.filterState, func(hp *envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy) string {
+			return hp.GetFilterState().GetKey()
+		}),
+		// The sourceIp scalar retains the higher-priority policy's value even when unset.
+		sourceIp: high.sourceIp,
+	}
+	merged.buildPolicies()
+
+	p1.spec.consistentHash = merged
+	mergeOrigins.Append("consistentHash", p2Ref, p2MergeOrigins)
+}
+
+func unionHashPolicies(
+	high, low []*envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy,
+	keyFn func(*envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy) string,
+) []*envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy {
+	if len(high) == 0 && len(low) == 0 {
+		return nil
+	}
+	seen := make(map[string]struct{}, len(high)+len(low))
+	var out []*envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy
+	for _, hp := range high {
+		k := keyFn(hp)
+		if _, exists := seen[k]; exists {
+			continue
+		}
+		seen[k] = struct{}{}
+		out = append(out, hp)
+	}
+	for _, hp := range low {
+		k := keyFn(hp)
+		if _, exists := seen[k]; exists {
+			continue
+		}
+		seen[k] = struct{}{}
+		out = append(out, hp)
+	}
+	return out
+}
